description: Ministry of Public Administration - Extended retirement age for the Medical Officers
reasoning: This gazette notification amends the Minutes on Pensions to extend the compulsory retirement age for medical officers in the public service. It deals specifically with public service retirement benefits and conditions, which falls under the Public Service category (Type 8) for public sector service conditions and benefits. While it is signed by a Minister, the content focuses on administrative rules for public servants rather than government structure, personnel changes, or detailed ministerial portfolios.
